description: This file contains utility functions related to Promise handling in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, including methods for creating, inspecting, waiting on, and aggregating promises.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A final class providing static utility methods for promise operations such as creating, inspecting, waiting, and combining promises within the GuzzleHttpomise namespace.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Returns the global task queue used for promise resolution, allowing optional assignment of a new queue instance.

methods.name: task
methods.description: Adds a callable task to the queue which returns a promise that fulfills or rejects based on task execution.

methods.name: inspect
methods.description: Synchronously waits on a promise and returns an array indicating its state, value, or reason if rejected.

methods.name: inspectAll
methods.description: Inspects multiple promises and returns an array of their inspection state arrays without waiting for rejection reasons.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Waits on all provided promises and returns their fulfilled values, throwing on rejection.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled when all promises are fulfilled, with an array of their values, or rejects if any promise is rejected.

methods.name: some
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled when a specified number of promises are fulfilled, rejecting if fewer are fulfilled.

methods.name: any
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with the first fulfilled value among provided promises or values.

methods.name: settle
methods.description: Returns a promise fulfilled with an array of inspection states for all provided promises, regardless of fulfillment or rejection.
